name: When should I choose a Level 5 drywall finish?

mainEntity.name: When should I choose a Level 5 drywall finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should choose a Level 5 drywall finish when the highest quality aesthetic is desired, especially in areas with critical lighting conditions or when using high-gloss or semi-gloss paints. Critical lighting includes large windows, skylights, or recessed lighting that casts strong light across wall surfaces, which can highlight even minor imperfections. Glossy paints reflect more light, making a perfectly smooth surface essential. A Level 5 finish involves a skim coat applied over the entire drywall surface, effectively eliminating texture differences and providing the smoothest possible substrate, ensuring a flawless appearance for premium finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a Level 5 drywall finish for the highest aesthetic quality, particularly with critical lighting (e.g., large windows) or when using gloss paints, as it provides the smoothest possible surface.
